description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling the DeleteFeatureProperty command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages deletion of feature properties from a Thing entity, generating appropriate events and results.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertyStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractThingCommandStrategy to handle DeleteFeatureProperty commands, performing feature property deletion and event generation.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command logic to delete a feature property, returning a Result containing a ThingEvent or an error.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Retrieves the specified feature from the Thing entity based on the command.

methods.name: getDeleteFeaturePropertyResult
methods.description: Creates a result after deleting the feature property, generating events and responses.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the EntityTag of the previous entity state related to the feature property.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional, indicating no next entity tag after deletion.
